title: Pistis 多模态大模型技术报告
summary: Pistis 模型家族包含 27B 和 9B 多模态大语言模型，基于 Qwen3.6/3.5，提出 IDRL 后训练范式，交替进行在线蒸馏与强化学习，提升知识迁移与长程智能体轨迹优化，并推出 Thinking 与 Agentic 两个变体及 PAH 推理框架自动优化方法。
summary_en: The Pistis model family introduces 27B and 9B multimodal LLMs built on Qwen3.6/3.5, featuring IDRL, a post-training paradigm that alternates on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning for better knowledge transfer and long-horizon agentic optimization, plus Thinking and Agentic variants and the PAH inference-harness optimization method.
